# hue_device (Data Source)

Look up a Hue device by UUID. Missing resources are errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hue_device" "desk" {
  id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

### Read-Only

- `light_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of light services owned by the device.
- `model_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Resource name.
